query: Which statistical checks and procedures detect and quantify feature correlations with protected attributes, and what mitigation methods are most effective?

response.query: Which statistical checks and procedures detect and quantify feature correlations with protected attributes, and what mitigation methods are most effective?
response.answer: Statistical checks like correlation analysis and fairness metrics detect feature correlations with protected attributes; mitigation methods include re-weighting training data and using pre-processing techniques like equalized odds.

results.title: GAO-16-89G, Schedule Assessment Guide
results.content: December 2015 GAO-16-89G Best Practices for Project Schedules Schedule Assessment Guide GAO-16-89G i Preface PREFACE The U.S. Government Accountability Office is responsible for, among other things, assisting the Congress in its oversight of the federal government, including agencies’ stewardship of public funds. When schedules are vertically traceable, lower-level schedules are clearly consistent with upper-level schedule milestones, allowing for total schedule integrity and enabling different teams to work to the same schedule expectations Work breakdown structure Deconstructs a program’s end product into successively greater levels of detail until the work is subdivided to a level suitable for management control Work package An activity or grouping of activities at the lowest level of the work breakdown structure, where work is planned and progress is measured GAO-16-89G 220 References REFERENCES AFMC (Air Force Materiel Command).
